title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: Cross-validation is used to evaluate the performance of a model by dividing the data into training and validation sets. Each fold uses a different part of the data for validation and the rest for training.

title: Analyzing the Errors
text: Look at the errors for each value of lambda across the folds. The goal is to choose the lambda that minimizes the error across all folds.

title: Comparing Lambda Values
text: For $$lambda=1$$, the errors are $$1$$ and $$3$$. For $$lambda=2$$, the errors are $$0.5$$ and $$1.5$$. For $$lambda=3$$, the errors are $$9$$ and $$1$$. Which lambda has the lowest average error?

title: Calculating Average Errors
text: Calculate the average error for each lambda value. What is the average error for $$lambda=2$$?

title: Choosing the Best Lambda
text: Based on the average errors, which lambda value should be chosen?
